data.action: 坐在长凳上品尝草莓冰淇淋，大号卫衣露出单肩，鲨鱼尾在凳后轻扫
data.camera: cowboy shot, medium shot, slight low angle
data.description: 【艾莲·乔 · 六分街夜市的冰淇淋补给】六分街繁华夜市的霓虹灯牌下，艾莲身穿宽松大号连帽卫衣，坐在便利店外的红色长凳上。她手握草莓甜筒冰淇淋小口品尝，双腿交叉晃荡，肥硕沉稳的鲨鱼尾巴在长凳后方蜷曲，冷淡的死鱼眼在尝到甜味的瞬间泛起极难察觉的满足微光。
data.lighting: 街头霓虹招牌与便利店橱窗溢出的暖白漫射光
data.location: 六分街便利店外街角长凳
data.promptProse: Ellen sits on the red bench outside the convenience store, tasting a strawberry cone in her oversized charcoal hoodie, denim shorts and striped knee socks. Her shark tail curls behind the bench as her tired red eyes soften slightly. The low cowboy view follows the night-market shopfronts behind. Neon colors touch her hair and cone rim, while warm-white window spill lights her holding hand and the bench slats.
data.title: 艾莲·乔 · 六分街夜市的冰淇淋补给
